MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
DevOps / Platform Engineering | QA Automation Engineer
marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, including recent work focused on CI/CD pipelines, test environments and build tooling. Owns delivery infrastructure for three product teams and has built short-lived Kubernetes test environments, improved pipeline speed and developed test observability. Complementary personal experience with k3s, GitOps, monitoring and Terraform-based VPS provisioning. Seeking to move into a DevOps or platform engineering role.

SKILLS
Infrastructure and delivery: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose, Helm, Kubernetes (namespace-level access; test environment deployments)
Infrastructure as code and cloud: Terraform (personal Hetzner VPS provisioning), AWS (personal learning: EC2 and S3 basics), Ansible (basic)
Observability and systems: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Linux, PostgreSQL, TLS certificate management with cert-manager (personal homelab)
Automation and testing: Python, Bash, pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman, Java (test code), SQL

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software | 2021-Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams (approximately 25 developers), including build, unit, integration and end-to-end test stages, and artifact publishing.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and separating end-to-end tests; reduced monthly CI runner costs by approximately 30%.
- Built merge-request test environments using Docker Compose and later Helm charts on the company's shared Kubernetes cluster; environments are automatically removed after merge or 48 hours of inactivity.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Developed Python and Bash tooling for PostgreSQL test-data seeding and built Grafana dashboards to track flaky tests using CI results.
- Wrote internal documentation explaining how CI works, which is used in onboarding; mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House | 2019-2021
- Performed manual and automated testing of web and mobile applications for client projects.
- Introduced a Selenium and Java automated regression suite for the largest client project.
- Configured Jenkins jobs for nightly regression runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018-2019
- Investigated customer issues using logs and databases, and reproduced bugs for developers.

SELECTED PROJECT
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024-2025
- Built a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster with applications deployed from a Git repository using Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki for monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS using Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS
BEng, Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) exam preparation; exam scheduled for January 2027

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role. My background is in QA automation, and in recent years my work has increasingly focused on the infrastructure behind reliable software delivery: CI/CD pipelines, short-lived environments and test tooling.

At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines used by three product teams and built merge-request environments deployed to a shared Kubernetes cluster with Helm. By parallelising jobs, adding dependency caching and reorganising end-to-end tests, I reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner costs by approximately 30%. I have also built Python and Bash tooling, documented the CI workflow for onboarding, and created Grafana dashboards that helped teams reduce flaky tests from 7% to below 1%.

Alongside my professional work, I built a three-node k3s homelab with Argo CD, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Traefik and cert-manager, and used Terraform to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS. This has given me practical experience with GitOps, monitoring, TLS certificate management and infrastructure as code, complementing my day-to-day work deploying test environments within a shared Kubernetes platform.

Corvale's work connecting a new train fleet with cloud services is a compelling infrastructure challenge: the platform needs to support data flows and remote updates while remaining observable, reliable and secure. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience improving delivery infrastructure and building practical automation could contribute to the fleet connectivity team.

Kind regards,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
